title: Sprint workers land clean
goal: kb-worker reads kb/_self by section, runs the sync gate's own checks and only its item checks and fast tests before it commits, and can run rag.py eval in its worktree; /kb-sprint falls back when kb-worker is not loaded, runs each orchestrator in its own clone or worktree, commits a bug filed while landing before its fix, and removes the sprint's worktrees and work branches at close; /kb-item joins an item to a started sprint before its work; test_research_merge ignores sprint worktrees

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
